description: Fixed 50:50 forecast average of vanila_mse and vanila_timse per seed (42/43/44), then fixed equal seed mean. No fitted weights and no labels used in averaging; both constituents are the published rows' own models. Published on explicit user request.

hyperparameters.aggregation: fixed equal mean: per seed 0.5*vanila_mse + 0.5*vanila_timse, then mean of seeds 42/43/44

offset.source: prior residuals on pre-cutoff calibration training rows
prior residuals on pre-cutoff calibration training rows

timse_config.timse_weight: w=N*c per lead; c = official 100-percentile tail-interval TIMSE coefficients computed from each fit's own training labels (sum c = 1)
